description: This Java class 'FormWidgetArtifactInfo' models metadata about form widgets in the OFBiz framework, including their relationships with entities, services, requests, and inheritance.

classes.name: FormWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata and relationships of a form widget in the OFBiz framework, including inheritance, associated entities, services, and linked requests.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates related entities, services, inheritance, and request links for this form widget.

methods.name: populateFormExtended
methods.description: Sets the form this form extends, if any, and updates reverse references.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity references used in the form based on a set of entity names.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service references used in the form based on a set of service names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Adds request links that are linked to this form.

methods.name: populateTargetedRequests
methods.description: Adds requests targeted by this form.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the form, including location info.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type 'Form Widget'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the artifact type ID for form widgets.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the form based on location and name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL location of the form.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on form name and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on toString() output.

methods.name: getEntitiesUsedInForm
methods.description: Returns the set of entity artifacts used in this form.

methods.name: getServicesUsedInForm
methods.description: Returns the set of service artifacts used in this form.

methods.name: getFormThisFormExtends
methods.description: Returns the form that this form extends, if any.

methods.name: getFormsExtendingThisForm
methods.description: Returns forms that extend this form.

methods.name: getScreensIncludingThisForm
methods.description: Returns screens that include this form.

methods.name: getRequestsLinkedToInForm
methods.description: Returns requests linked to this form.

methods.name: getRequestsTargetedByForm
methods.description: Returns requests targeted by this form.
